updates.content:
Title:  We’ve detected an issue with auto-created configs for Microsoft Purview inline data protections in Edge for Business 

User impact: If action isn’t taken, collection and DLP policies for user data uploads to unmanaged apps might not work as expected. 

Current status: We’ve identified through error monitoring activities that some required configurations to activate Purview collections and DLP policies in the Edge for Business browser might be missing in your tenant.  
  
The additional policies required to activate Purview collections and DLP policies in the Edge for Business browser might be missing in your tenant. For more information on this feature, review the message center post MC1151234 and find a detailed description of the activation process, permissions needed, and policies created here in our learn docs: Activate your DLP policy in Microsoft Edge | Microsoft Learn 
  
Please review the recommendations provided to prevent any service interruptions.  


Expiration message: This communication will expire in 14 days, and is scheduled to remain active for the full duration.
